quickRoute: Five diagnostic probes route to specific lessons. Use Quick recall and independent lesson checkpoints before the four-question mixed recall.
fullRoute: Work components, arithmetic and directions, dot products and projections, ordered cross products, then lines/planes and coordinate systems. Predict in each activity, explain differences, and save reasoning in notes.

support.reason: Recover exact fractions, radicals, and signed arithmetic.
Review coordinate reading, signed changes, and geometric distances.
Recover standard angles, sine/cosine signs, and angle conventions.
Check compatible units and distinguish dimensions from physical meaning.
Resolve forces, calculate displacement and work, and interpret supplied torque models.
Prepare vector geometry and coordinate conventions for fields.
Develop vector methods and coordinate geometry in the full engineering mathematics course.
Prepare projections and component reasoning for signal representations.
Use projection and component ideas when studying digital signal methods.
Interpret spatial directions, coordinate frames, and sensor quantities.
Read spatial coordinates and geometric relations in engineering models.

escalation.text: Use the linked free OpenStax Calculus Volume 3 sections for first-time instruction. CEE 300 and the full physics courses are the corresponding course destinations; their vector learning packs are not yet authored in this baseline. F03 and F04 provide available coordinate and trigonometry support.
